turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm a bit tired, but okay. My tummy is sore, and I feel a little nauseous.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: I understand. On a scale from 0 to 10, how would you rate your pain right now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe around 4 or 5. It's manageable, but I can feel it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. Have you felt any sickness or vomited at all since coming out of anesthesia?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, not yet. Just a bit of a queasy feeling, but I haven't thrown up.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. How about your breathing? Any shortness of breath or discomfort in your chest?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I'm breathing fine. Just a bit of a sore throat from the tube, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's common after intubation. Do you remember anything from the surgery itself?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don't remember anything. I was out completely.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected. Since you have hypertension and diabetes, we'll keep a close eye on your vitals and blood sugar levels. Any other concerns for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that's all for now. Thank you, doctor.
